description.value: A large, popular lakeshore campground in mixed Douglas fir and aspen forest, 30 minutes from Kamloops, with 400 m of sandy beach, stocked rainbow trout fishing, and a trail to Gibraltar Rock; arrives full quickly in peak summer.

address.value: Paul Lake Provincial Park, Thompson-Nicola, BC V2C 6Z2, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a BC Parks campground within Paul Lake Park, featuring 90 sites (OSM capacity tag), a sani-station, beach, boat launch, and 7+ km of hiking trails, all within a 30-minute drive of Kamloops. Reservations are confirmed by the prominent 'Book camping' link and 'Reservation policies' section on the BC Parks page. An open-air shower is mentioned in the swimming/day-use section. OSM tags for internet_access=no and power_supply=no are noted but not confirmed by website text. No phone number appears in the fetched website content, so phone confirmation is null.
concerns: No street address available; access is via Pinantan Road, 19 km from Hwy 5 north of Kamloops
OSM website URL uses the legacy env.gov.bc.ca/bcparks domain which may eventually redirect to bcparks.ca

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established BC Parks campground with 90 sites, a sani-station, beach, and hiking trails, conveniently located near Kamloops — a solid stop for touring cyclists on the Thompson corridor.

wow_evidence: 400 m of sandy beach… open-air shower… 90 sites
